name: Acumatica
summary: Acumatica is a cloud ERP whose financial management covers the general ledger, bank feeds and reconciliation, and customizable financial statements. It publishes no price. Cost is set by the applications a company implements, expected usage and deployment choice, and the page promises unlimited users on one price quoted after a pricing review.

facts.text: Acumatica's pricing page says cost is based on the applications you need, your expected usage and resource requirements, and your deployment preferences.
The pricing page is headed Unlimited Users. One Transparent Price, yet it publishes no figure and offers a custom pricing review instead.
The financial management page describes ledger automation across multiple entities, currencies, countries and books.

plans.name: Custom quote
plans.notes: Priced by applications implemented, expected usage and deployment choice

hiddenCosts: No price is published, so the total depends on the applications chosen.
